card.name: Brain anatomy and brain-gene text
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation in neuroanatomy and brain-gene passages, just before a region, part or gene name. Examples are 'by the terminal vein', 'expressed in brain regions', and a citation's closing bracket before the next gene name.

modes.label: Neuroanatomy wording
modes.description: Small words or word pieces inside descriptions of brain structures and their divisions.
modes.example: It is separated laterally from the caudate nucleus by a white band, the stria terminalis, and by the<< terminal>> vein.

modes.label: Gene list in brain-evolution text
modes.description: Citation close or bracket or linking word just before a gene name or its description.

modes.label: Linking word before region or part
modes.description: Words like in, into, by or of that lead into a brain region, subdivision or trait.
modes.example: This gene encodes multiple copies of the protein DUF1220, which is expressed<< in>> brain regions associated with higher cognitive function.

card.writes: It leans toward region, area and map words, mostly in Chinese and code-style tokens.
card.plain: It marks spots in brain anatomy and gene passages where a region or area name is likely to come next.
